control.provenance: The frozen arm-B binary of the comparison-routing correction campaign

secondary.application: Compare each per-task candidate median against control. A strictly greater ratio flags a regression; candidate positive against control zero flags without division. Flags prevent blanket efficiency claims and require route analysis. They do not automatically discard improved functional coverage.

decision_rule.zero_comparator: For primary ratio gates, both zero passes; positive candidate against zero control fails.
decision_rule.interpretation: Correctness precedes cost. Retain each valid failure, incomplete run, recovery and exhausted budget in all-run totals. Report per-task medians/ranges, paired directions and totals. These practical diagnostic gates do not establish statistical equivalence. Passing nonregression limits alone is not a speedup. Treat this as a combined help package; do not attribute effects to individual sentences. This regression check compares the complete candidate against the last checked version on the tasks its desk review flagged; it does not remeasure the other tasks.
decision_rule.stopping: Run only the first frozen 24 sessions. Never pool prior trials, replace valid failures or add repetitions. A correction requires a new candidate and frozen protocol before further trials. Invalid context, unsupported actual model/effort, missing/corrupt telemetry or fixture/instrumentation failures make affected evidence inadmissible; do not silently substitute trials.

integrity: Freeze exact protocol, schedule, tasks, expected artifacts/interpretations, native binary hashes and each arm source provenance before launching any explorer. Keep preparation repository snapshot provenance separate from prebuilt-binary source declarations. At most three pairs run concurrently and arms run sequentially inside each pair. Preserve identical inputs, locale, terminal/width behavior, isolated personal defaults and budgets across arms. Independent fresh MEDIUM agents receive no repository documentation, prior answers, telemetry or outside-scratch access.
review: Independently grade artifacts and final answers with condition/resource labels concealed; audit actual model/effort, initial context, final cumulative counters, isolation, order, hashes and fixture integrity. Missing required work is incomplete; corrected mistakes may pass but retain recovery cost. Do not silently repair artifacts.
telemetry: Record agent-facing calls, shell executions, CLI invocations, uncached input (input minus cached), cached input, output including reasoning without double counting, guide/schema retrievals and final-delivery duration separately. Evaluator/reviewer work is excluded. The duration field uses the existing harness elapsed-through-completion/copying measurement, not exact native final-message latency.
evidence: Retain raw sessions and account/framework context only in Git-ignored docs/research/local/agent-explorability. Public results contain portable synthetic summaries and provenance, never raw session/account content.

task_roles.4: Routine saved comparison execution and interpretation target
task_roles.7: Complete capability and requested-semantic discovery guard

candidate_change: Only add explicit optional-reference execution routing for routine saved comparisons to root and compare long help; retain all existing recipes, feature inventory, guides, schemas and measurement behavior.
hypothesis: Explicit routing may reduce routine saved-comparison work. The original traces showed batching and verification variation; reading the comparison guide is not established as the cause of its call-count regression.
coverage_boundary: Evaluate only these four freshly paired tasks. Do not pool the original 80 sessions or other historical trials into any correctness rate, median, total or gate. The remaining six original tasks are not remeasured by this bounded correction; retain their original outcomes and secondary flags separately.
